value.rationale: The minimum number of point evaluations that determine an affine polynomial is exactly two. Optimizing their placement in newly constructed arc function planes is a natural sharp finite sampling problem; gives a unique nonlinear optimal node position, full exact conditioning law, and bounded cb distortion in the near-full-circle regime where naive endpoint sampling diverges. No downstream theorem is asserted; the exact design is itself useful.
